name: Strip Scan Glitch
description: Slices the image into vertical strips that scroll at hashed, brightness-weighted speeds with sideways tears, RGB split and a bass scan bar; mouse X sets strip density and mouse Y the scroll speed. Ideas: vertical-blanking seam (each strip's wrap shows a black blanking bar with sync-pulse ticks and a soft smear on the rows either side), held brake (holding the pointer drags the strips under the cursor to a freeze-frame halt with treble flutter, releasing back to speed), and speed-streak ghost (fast strips leave a short vertical smear read from the previous frame). ACES display.
